        "final": npv,
        "pv_staged_capex": pv_capex,
        "pv_operating_inflows": pv_inflows,
        "pv_wc_adjustments": pv_wc_adj,
        "pv_wc_release": pv_wc_release,
    }

def solve():
    r = Q("0.12")
    disc = lambda t: 1 / (1 + r) ** t

    # Staged capex: 5000 at t=0, 3000 at beginning of year 2 (t=1)
    pv_capex = Q(5000) * disc(0) + Q(3000) * disc(1)

    # Operating inflows at end of years 1..3, growth 0%
    g = Q(0)
    inflows = [Q(5000) * (1 + g) ** (t - 1) for t in range(1, 4)]
    pv_inflows = sum(inflows[t - 1] * disc(t) for t in range(1, 4))

    # WC balance for year t set at beginning of year t (time t-1) = 25% of year-t inflow
    wc_rate = Q("0.25")
    prev = Q(0)
    pv_wc_adj = Q(0)  # positive = net outflow
    for t in range(1, 4):
        bal = wc_rate * inflows[t - 1]
        pv_wc_adj += (bal - prev) * disc(t - 1)
        prev = bal

    # At end of year 3, 60% of final balance recovered
    pv_release = Q("0.6") * prev * disc(3)

    npv = -pv_capex + pv_inflows - pv_wc_adj + pv_release
    return {
        "final": npv,
        "pv_staged_capex": pv_capex,
        "pv_operating_inflows": pv_inflows,
        "pv_wc_adjustments": pv_wc_adj,
        "pv_wc_release": pv_release,
    }
